answer: I would stop farms with palm-vein pattern binding to one key, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 654 aliases would need 654 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The ridge test is the live device, the lantern test is the locked stake, and the opal test is the graded history no template can fake. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
